title: Design and create recipe database schema
description:
Create Supabase tables: recipes (id, user_id, title, description, image_url, source_url, servings, prep_time, cook_time, ingredients JSONB, steps JSONB, notes, rating, created_at, updated_at), recipe_groups (id, user_id, name), recipe_group_items (group_id, recipe_id). Add Row Level Security policies for user data isolation.

- All tests must pass before marking complete

title: Build Python recipe scraper service
description:
Create FastAPI service with endpoint POST /scrape that accepts {url: string}. Use recipe-scrapers library to extract: title, image, ingredients, instructions, yields, total_time, host. Return structured JSON. Handle errors gracefully for unsupported sites. Include CORS configuration.

**Files:** scraper/main.py, scraper/requirements.txt, scraper/models.py, scraper/tests/*

**Testing Requirements:**
- Unit tests for scraping logic with mocked HTML responses
- Test error handling for invalid URLs
- Test error handling for unsupported sites
- Test CORS headers are set correctly
- Integration test with real recipe URL (can be skipped in CI)
- All tests must pass before marking complete
close_reason: Created FastAPI scraper service with POST /scrape endpoint using recipe-scrapers library. Includes CORS, error handling, and 7 passing unit tests.
